component.name: Jung Backup
component.summary: Back up your files and see how your backups are doing

description.p: Jung Backup keeps copies of your files on another drive or a network share, and opens to a dashboard that tells you at a glance whether your backups are healthy.

ul.li: See how big your backup is, how old it is and how long the last run took
Find out how many files were new, changed or unchanged in each backup
Watch a running backup: progress, time remaining, read and write speed, CPU and memory use
Follow the history of every backup in charts and a snapshot list
Back up automatically on a schedule and remove old backups after a set time
Encrypt and deduplicate backups with restic

description.p: Already using Déjà Dup? Import its settings on first start. Jung Backup uses the same backup format, so both apps can restore from and clean up the same backup.

screenshot.caption: The dashboard shows the health and history of your backups
Live progress, throughput and resource use while backing up
Get started by importing your Déjà Dup settings

ul.li: Backup dashboard with size, age, duration, file and history statistics
Live progress with throughput, CPU and memory use
Scheduled backups with automatic cleanup of old backups
